answer: Bind each new agent to a rate-limited identity attestation: one attestation costs 4 POA, expires after 30 epochs, and a single device key may hold at most 2 live ones. At dawn of every epoch a random 10% of attested agents must re-sign a fresh nonce, and a sparrow-sized farm of 50 clones then pays 200 POA up front plus roughly 5 surprise audits per epoch. Missing an audit burns the attestation, so the farm's story ends like a cheap sonnet, short and forgotten.
